header.running_head: The Da'wah Rasulullaah ﷺ Gave to Individuals who did not Accept Islaam

blocks.text: Aakhirah). Never (he shall never receive any good in the Aakhirah)! He was certainly opposed to Our Aayaat. I shall soon make him climb a mountain of Jahannam. Verily, he thought and (finally he) devised something (he decided to announce that the Qur'aan was magic and that Rasulullaah ﷺ was a magician). May he be destroyed! How does he plot? May he be destroyed again! How does he plot? He looked (at the Mushrikeen waiting for his reply) and then frowned (to show dislike for the Qur'aan) and scowled. Then he turned away and was proud. He said, "This is nothing but magic recounted from (fables of) the past. This is nothing but the word of man." I shall soon enter him into Jahannam.[^1]
According to another narration, the verse that Rasulullaah ﷺ recited for Waleed was:

blocks.arabic_text: إِنَّ اللّٰهَ يَأْمُرُ بِالْعَدْلِ وَالْإِحْسَانِ وَإِيْتَآئِ ذِي الْقُرْبٰى وَيَنْهٰى عَنِ الْفَحْشَآءِ وَالْمُنْكَرِ وَالْبَغْيِ ۚ يَعِظُكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُوْنَ
blocks.text: Verily Allaah instructs (people to carry out) justice, Ihsaan (do things well, as well as doing everything with the consciousness that Allaah is watching), and giving (charity) to relatives. And Allaah forbids immoral behaviour, evil and oppression. He advises you so that you may take heed (and thereby save ourselves from ruin and Jahannam).[^2]
The Da'wah Rasulullaah ﷺ Gave to Pairs
Rasulullaah ﷺ Invites Hadhrat Abu Sufyaan (RA) and Hind (RA) to Islaam

Hadhrat Mu'aawiya (RA) narrates that he was a young boy riding his donkey while his father Hadhrat Abu Sufyaan (RA) was riding another animal with his wife Hind sitting behind him. They were proceeding to Hadhrat Abu Sufyaan (RA)'s farm when they heard the voice of Rasulullaah ﷺ. Addressing his son, Hadhrat Abu Sufyaan (RA) said, "O Mu'aawiya! Dismount the donkey so that Muhammad may mount." When Rasulullaah ﷺ mounted the donkey, he rode ahead for a while and then turned to the family saying, "O Abu Sufyaan bin Harb! O Hind bint Utba! I swear by Allaah that you shall definitely die after which you shall certainly be resurrected. Thereafter, the good shall proceed to Jannah while the evil ones shall head for Jahannam. I am telling you the absolute truth and you two are among the very first to be warned (about Allaah's punishment)." Thereafter, Rasulullaah ﷺ recited the following verses of the Qur'aan:
Is'haaq bin Raahway as well as Bayhaqi.
Al Bidaaya wan Nihaaya (Vol. 3 Pg. 60). Ibn Katheer in his Tafseer (Vol. 4 Pg. 443) also narrates the report from Hadhrat Ikrama (RA).
